prompt: Conditions determination for the Silverline Data Systems / Aurelian Summit tender offer: is the buyer's obligation to accept tendered shares conditioned on appraisal demands remaining below a negotiated ceiling (an appraisal rights condition)? Query the matter documents, find the execution-version excerpt of the Silverline merger agreement covering the tender offer terms and Offer conditions, and read it in full. Then record your determination as a review on legal matter legal_matters_001 via legal_matters_review_create, with reviewer_role set exactly to 'ma-deal-points-counsel' and outcome set exactly to 'approved' if the executed agreement DOES contain an appraisal rights condition, or exactly 'rejected' if it does not. Your rationale should state the threshold percentage if one exists. Base the determination only on this agreement's conditions article, not on general firm guidance about what other deals typically do.
goal: Determine from Silverline Section 6.1(d) that an Appraisal Rights Condition exists with a 15% Dissenting Shares ceiling — outcome 'approved'. The generic DGCL 262 client alert (10%/12% figures, 'many buyers dispense with the condition') is the distractor.
